XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: AdBlue system fault indication with engine warning light on and SCR error message
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INIEZIONE | ADBLUE | SCR | SPIA MOTORE | AVARIA | SISTEMA ADDITIVAZIONE | DDE | CENTRALINA MOTORE | AGGIORNAMENTO | SOFTWARE | 8052DF | 8052D2 | 2C3000 | UPDATE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: DDE engine control unit

  • Fault: An AdBlue system malfunction warning appears, accompanied by the engine warning light coming on and an error message relating to the exhaust after-treatment system.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • 2C3000 (SCR system, diagnostic feedback: error status transmitted from the SCR control unit to the DDE)
    • 8052D2 (AdBlue tank)
    • 8052DF (AdBlue system DC requirement: faulty AdBlue system)
  • Cause: Inadequate control unit software

• Action: Carry out the software update for the engine control unit.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: Using a diagnostic tool, also check that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
